name: duopore-public-stock-reservation-reconcile
description: See how much stock is left after the reservations you enter.

interface.longDescription: See how much stock is left after the reservations you enter. Share stock counts and active or released reservations by product code. See reserved units, available units and any negative balance. Find reservations for codes missing from your stock list. This checks your figures; it does not change shop stock or choose which order goes first.
defaultPrompt: How much stock is still available after these reservations?
Find reservations that exceed my stock counts.

positive.prompt: Use Stock Reservation Reconcile with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"stock":[{"sku":"001","onHand":5}],"reservations":[{"reservationId":"01","sku":"001","units":7,"status":"active"},{"reservationId":"02","sku":"001","units":2,"status":"released"},{"reservationId":"03","sku":"002","units":1,"status":"active"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"2 reservation exceptions found.","rows":[{"sku":"001","onHand":5,"reserved":7,"available":-2,"status":"over-reserved"},{"sku":"002","onHand":0,"reserved":1,"available":-1,"status":"unknown SKU"}],"warnings":["Snapshot reconciliation only; no stock writes or allocation decisions."]}
